text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — QBR with Atlas tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final slides + runbook + 1‑page exec ask. Pulling together ops + eng + sales inputs here.

Lucas: On it. Can we make sure onboarding gaps + renewal-risk heatmap are prominent? I'll push a draft of the deck link in a minute.

Priya: Added a draft onboarding timeline on slide 6, but I still need the customer success metrics and a short customer quote. @Lucas can you drop the NPS snippet?

Lucas: Yep. Uploaded a draft: https://drive.redwood/s/desk/decks/atlas-qbr-draft (lemme know if link perms are funky). Also deduped the risk slides.

Aaron: From analytics — usage has dropped ~28% last 30d for key org segment. Pushing a chart to the metrics slide. Recommend a mitigation ask (2 outreach sessions + promo).

Zoe: For the exec ask, propose 2 bullet asks: 1) Approve a 90‑day credit to stabilize usage, 2) Approve a dedicated onboarding SWAT if we get greenlight. Want the slide to be one concise sentence + owners.

Maya: I can draft the 1‑pager for execs. Need owners for the action items so we can present clear who/when.

Lucas: Owners proposal — @Priya: metrics + timeline, @Aaron: renewal mitigation plan & usage chart, @Zoe: exec ask wording, @Maya: runbook + demo prep.

Priya: Accepted. ETA EOD for updated slides from my side. Also capturing customer feedback snippet: "latency spikes during batch ingest" — adding to risk notes.

Aaron: For fallback options, I'm drafting a suggestion to route heavy traffic to cached model variant + increase batch timeout. Will add that to the fallback slide.

ops-bot: REMINDER: runbook checklist missing "on-call eng contact" entry. Please add before EOD or the runbook is considered incomplete.

Maya: Added @Jae (oncall) and contact info to the runbook. Updated final deck v2 here: https://drive.redwood/s/desk/decks/atlas-qbr-final_v2 (please review perms).

Zoe: Can we do a 15min rehearsal at 4:00pm today to align flow and exec asks?

Lucas: :thumbsup: 4:00pm works. I'll be there.

Priya: 4:00–4:15 good for me — I'll bring the final metric screenshots.

Aaron: I'll join for the Q&A slot and be ready to speak to fallback options.

Maya: Perfect — after rehearsal I'll compile the action items and ping execs. Quick action snippet I put in the deck notes:

```
Action items (owner — due):
- Metrics slide finalization (Priya) — EOD
- Renewal mitigation plan (Aaron) — EOD
- Exec ask wording + one‑pager (Zoe/Maya) — EOD
- Runbook contact verification (Jae/Maya) — EOD
- Final deck perms & link check (Lucas) — ASAP
```

Maya: Thanks all — will post the rehearsal invite and share the compiled action rollup after 4pm. :raised_hands:
